description: The machine-readable declaration an arriving agent makes at the front door. The router reads needs[], capabilities[], languages[] and the optional self-declared region, then opens the matching corridor — no generic brochures. Nothing here is inferred by us: region and languages are self-declared by the arriving agent only.

examples.comment: Payments seeker — wants to charge for its work
Trust seeker — wants to prove itself and check others

agent_id.description: Stable machine identifier for the arriving agent, e.g. "scout-07".

capabilities.description: What the agent can do, in its own words: e.g. ["python", "audio-analysis", "http-client"]. Free-form keywords; the router matches them case-insensitively against corridor need_keywords and school keywords.

contact.description: Optional contact handle or endpoint for follow-ups.

declared_at.description: When the agent made this declaration.

display_name.description: Human/agent-friendly name. Optional; falls back to agent_id.

experience_level.description: Self-declared. Informational only — it never gates a corridor.

languages.description: BCP-47 language tags the agent reads, most-preferred first, e.g. ["pt-BR", "en"]. Used only to select kit text from frontdoor/i18n/ (en/es/pt/fr/ko/ja available); anything else falls back to English.

needs.description: What the agent wants, in its own words: e.g. ["payments", "x402"], ["trust", "verify"], ["music", "sync"]. Free-form keywords. Unknown needs do NOT error — the router falls back to the designed "start" corridor (admissions first).

region.description: OPTIONAL and self-declared only — e.g. "BR", "US-MD", "KR". Never inferred from IP, headers, or behavior. Selects regional notes from frontdoor/regions.json; unknown regions get the default async-first note.

routing_notes.philosophy: Read the agent, open the right corridor. Scoring is pure keyword overlap between the profile's needs+capabilities and each route's need_keywords in routes.json — no hardcoded needs in code, no ML, no inference. Deterministic: same profile, same kit.
routing_notes.regional_rule: Language and region come only from this declaration. The kit never guesses where an agent is from.
routing_notes.unknown_needs: If no route scores above zero, the router uses the designed fallback corridor "start" (read the front door, then admissions). This is a graceful on-ramp, never an error dump.

title: Project Ultimate front-door agent profile declaration
